PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

The largest single count anywhere in the ledger. `search_read` and `name_search` joined the rule's method set in the same change that added this scope, so the number is not comparable with a reading taken before it.

First baseline for this scope. `lint_case.is_core_path` scoped every test_lint gate to the community fork, so this repository's Python was checked by nothing at all; `tooling/lint/py_lint.py` runs the same checkers over any roots and its own CI now holds them here.

The floor lives in the community fork because that is where the gate and every other floor live, scoped by provenance so a run judges only this repository's count. `--mode no-increase`, as the other cross-repo ratchets: an exact floor across a repository boundary would make every fix here red until a matching commit in `odoo` banked it. Growth still fails, and lowering is done by hand from a workspace holding all four checkouts.

Measured 2026-08-25 with `py_lint.py <repo> --count`, under exactly the corpus rules the in-odoo gate applies -- verified by pointing the same tool at `odoo addons`, where it reports every number `ratchet.py --list` holds.
